• +6 Strength
• +3 Dexterity
• +2 Bow, Endurance, and Pugilism Skills
• +2 DR

options.notes:
• Size: Medium (4)
• +5 Dexterity
• +3 Web Spell, which costs half the normal Mana to cast
• +2 Climbing, Perception, and Performance (with a stringed instrument specialty) Skills
• You have an innate Climb Move equal to your normal Move value, without needing Checks (unless under duress)

options.name: Cat
options.notes:
• Size: Small (2); Animal
• +4 Dexterity
• +2 Constitution
• +1 Charisma
• −3 Strength
• +3 Cat-like Reflexes
• +2 Slice Attack Skill
• Can see in total darkness
• Advantage on Cat-like Reflexes Skill Checks
• Nine Lives: Take half damage from the first 9 attacks each day
• Vulnerability: Take double damage from Dogs and Beasts

options.notes:
• Size: Medium (4)
• +3 Dexterity and Charisma
• −2 Constitution
• +2 Cat-like Reflexes, Good First Impression, Light on your Feet, and Slice Attack Skills

• When dealing with felines other than Cat Girls/ Boys, you make Charisma-based Skill Checks with Disadvantage

options.name: Changbi Demon
options.notes:
• Size: Medium (4)
• +5 Dexterity
• +3 Strength and Constitution
• −2 Charisma
• +3 Ambush and Creepy Chains (Club) Skills
• Creepy Chains: Can use any chain as a weapon (use the Club Weapon Skill, but with a 10ft range). A Changbi Demon can lengthen or shorten any chain by 50% once per scene
• Each time a foe touches a Changbi Demon with their bare skin (such as with Hand-to-Hand attacks), that foe takes 1d4+F Acid
• No need to breathe
• Vulnerable to Holy damage
• Cannot worship a deity

options.name: Changeling
options.notes:
• Size: Large (5)
• +3 Charisma
• +2 Intelligence
• +2 Ambush and Deception Skills
• +1 Escape Artist Skill
• Advantage on Deception Skill Checks when no talking is needed
• Changelings gain free access to organizations and producers by impersonating other crawlers and Syndicate celebrities, but can only use those relevant to the currently shifted individual
• Changeling Shapeshifting: A Changeling who touches a member of another Race can shapeshift themselves into that Race, building a “library” of Races they can transform into. A Changeling can shapeshift into another Race as an Action to make an Unopposed Deception Skill Check. While shapeshifted into that other Race, they gain that Race’s bonuses other than statistics and Skills. For example, a Changeling shapeshifted into a Crocodilian would gain the Race’s Advantage on Intimidation Skill Checks, DR Buff, bonus after a full meal, and additional fatigue penalty on Charisma-based Checks
• While shapeshifted into another Race, these changes are conveyed to World Dungeon systems, including information on viewers’ HUDs, mini-maps, and other systems
• Changelings can’t touch mimics- type creatures. Don’t ask why or what happens—it’s bad

options.name: Crocodilian
options.notes:
• Size: Large (5)
• +4 Strength
• +3 Constitution
• +2 Pugilism and Powerful Strike Skills
• When physically menacing someone in person, roll Intimidate Skill Checks with Advantage
• +3 DR Buff

• While you have the Fatigued Debuff, roll all Charisma-based Checks with Disadvantage

options.name: Doppelgänger
options.notes:

• Doppelgänger Shape-Changing: As an Action, you can transform into any shape of comparable mass, incorporating carried and worn items into the new shape in the same percentage (that is, a Doppelgänger holding metal equal to half their weight must assume a shape that is one-third metal). This transformation is painful, causing you to mark off 1 Health Bar slot per change. If you attempt to change your shape to resemble a specific person or object, do so with an Unopposed Deception Skill Check

options.name: Dwarf, Classic

• −2 Charisma

options.notes:

options.notes:
• Size: Medium (4)

• No Survival Checks needed in harsh heat conditions and can breathe underwater

• Lose 1 Health Bar slot each time you access your Inventory (not Hotlist)
• Disadvantage on Checks to conceal your presence or nature (such as Stealth)

options.name: Lajabless
options.notes:

abilities.name: Acute Ears
abilities.description: Intelligence Passive Improves a crawler’s hearing and allows the crawler to see more Mobs on the minimap in their HUD. abilities.name: Aiming
abilities.description: Passive ranged-attack support. Mark only when applying its Ranks to the qualifying ranged Attack.

abilities.name: Alchemy
abilities.description: Intelligence Used for crafting potions and poisons. See Crafting p. 221. You may craft potions up to a +5 bonus level. UPGRADES Rank 5: You may craft potions up to a +10 bonus level. Rank 10: You may create additional potions of the same kind without spending extra time. Rank 15: You can write the recipe for any potion you find.

abilities.name: Ambush
abilities.description: Intelligence You are skilled at popping up out of nowhere. When a Mob is moving toward you, even if they are aware of your general presence, make an Int-Opposed Skill Check. On Success, you gain a surprise Action against the Mob before combat starts. As an unseen attacker, you Attack with Advantage. UPGRADES Rank 5: If you Attack with your Surprise Action, add an Ambush Rank damage die to your Surprise Attack damage. Rank 10: When other crawlers in your party roll this skill untrained, they roll as normal (not with Disadvantage). “That is the equivalent of dropping a grenade down your pants and shouting, ‘Yolo!’”

abilities.name: Animal Handling
abilities.description: Refer to the listed entry for conditions, damage, cooldowns, and Rank upgrades. Effects are adjudicated at the table.

abilities.name: Arcane
abilities.description: Intelligence You have general knowledge of magic and can de- termine whether items are magical or not. Make an Unopposed Skill Check. On Success, you can identify the item as magical or not. UPGRADES Rank 5: You are able to determine details such as the specific Rank and bonus levels of magical items. Rank 10: You can imbue items with inherent spells using an Arcanist Table. See Crafting on p. 221. Rank 15: The default cooldown of your imbued spells is 3 hours.

abilities.name: Attack of Opportunity
abilities.description: Passive Interrupt. Requires a one-handed melee weapon with reach no greater than 5ft. Spend an Action to attack a foe leaving an adjacent space except via Step. Timing and upgrades are manual.

abilities.name: Backfire
abilities.description: Intelligence Limitations: Compensated Anarchist Class Only You are skilled at neutralizing and deconstructing traps without the use of a Sapper’s Table. Triggering mecha- nisms are quite valuable. Time required to neutralize a trap is 10 minutes. Time required to deconstruct it is 1 hour. Make an Unopposed Skill Check. On Success, you successfully take apart the trap and can repurpose it. UPGRADES Rank 5: You can identify when the trap was placed. Time required to neutralize a trap is 5 minutes. Rank 10: You can identify when the trap was created. Time required to deconstruct a trap is 30 minutes. Rank 15: You can identify the designer of the trap. Time required to deconstruct a trap is 15 minutes.

abilities.name: Balance
abilities.description: Dexterity You can traverse tricky surfaces with general ease. Make an Unopposed Skill Check. The GM may add Difficulty for especially crazy surfaces. On Success, you keep your balance on tricky or shift- ing surfaces. UPGRADES Rank 5: You may perform Move Actions in difficult terrain without penalty. Rank 10: When subject to a Take Down or involuntary Move effects, you may use this skill as a free Interrupt Action to avoid the effect. Rank 15: You may perform your Step on vertical surfaces (yes, like in The Matrix), but must end it on a flat(ish) surface.

abilities.name: Basic Science
abilities.description: Intelligence You understand basic scientific principles and natural laws, which you hope are still in effect in the dungeon. If you want to conduct experiments involving dead Goblins and various acids, this is the Skill for you. Experiments take 2 hours to perform. Make an Unopposed Skill Check. On Success, you learn or confirm something. UPGRADES Rank 5: Experiments take 1 hour to perform. Rank 10: Choose a specialty (physics, biology, chemis- try, Earth science, etc.), and roll with Advantage when dealing with that. Rank 15: Experiments take 30 minutes to perform.

abilities.name: Bomb Surgeon
abilities.description: Intelligence Use this Skill to deconstruct explosive bombs and smoke bombs. You can then use the half-sized bomb, or use the component parts to craft new bombs using other Skills. If you are using a Sapper’s Table, you do not have to make an Unopposed Explosives Handling Skill Check to avoid a mishap. Time required is 1 hour. Make an Unopposed Skill Check. On Success, you have deconstructed it. UPGRADES Rank 5: Time required is 30 minutes. Rank 10: You never have to make an Explosives Han- dling Skill Check when using this skill. Rank 15: When cutting dynamite in half to make small- er bombs, round dice up. Time required is 15 minutes.

abilities.name: Calligraphy
abilities.description: Dexterity Used for making documents look super elegant. Make an Unopposed Skill Check. On Success, what you have written is a joy to read and feels important, even if it’s bad news. UPGRADES Rank 5: Roll with Advantage on your next Charisma Skill Check vs. the recipient of your beautiful paper. Rank 10: You are able to craft scrolls as if this were a crafting skill. See Crafting, p. 221. Rank 15: Once per floor, you may craft a scroll for a spell you have only seen cast within the last 2 hours.

abilities.name: Cartography
abilities.description: Intelligence You probably played some old-school TTRPGs and think that mapping the dungeon will help you in some way. Wrong! It will help you in many ways. Make an Unopposed Skill Check. On Success, you figure out where you are in relation to other things. UPGRADES Rank 5: You can always return from whence you came quickly, assuming the dungeon walls haven’t shifted in the meantime. Rank 10: You provide an Advantage die to crawlers in your party (could be you) who are making Tracking Skill Checks or Checks that rely on spatial relations. Rank 15: Even with merely a finger point or a “that- taway,” you can get from point A to point B via the most direct path.

abilities.name: Cat-Like Reflexes
abilities.description: Dexterity Limitation: This limited Skill is only available to cat- based Races, such as Cat, Cat Girl/Cat Boy, and Tigran You gain a +10ft Move. Use this Skill Check when you would make a Dexterity Stat Check (vs. the typically lesser Stat Check Difficulty). UPGRADES Rank 5: Reduce the damage you take from foes’ Sur- prise Attacks against you by your Rank in this skill. Rank 10: Reduce all Area damage you take by 50% (rounded down). Rank 15: +10ft Move. You gain a +1 Evade Buff. Roll with Advantage to Evade Attacks and effects that would apply the Held Debuff (or similar) to you.

abilities.name: Catcher

abilities.name: Cesta Punta
abilities.description: Dexterity Limitations: Only acquired via an Earth Hobby Potion Use this Skill Check when playing jai alai or when throwing things that fit in the xistera. See Throwing p. 200 for rules on throwing things, but use the ranges below. Roll with Disadvantage at rang- es over 500 feet. UPGRADES Rank 5: Throw range Strength ×20 feet. Rank 10: Add 1 Cesta Punta Rank damage die to thrown damaging Attacks. Rank 15: Throw range Strength ×30 feet, and roll with Disadvantage at ranges over 2,000 feet.

abilities.name: Character Actor
abilities.description: Passive, Charisma Limitations: Former Child Actor Class Only. Rank increases by 1 when descending to a new floor only. At the start of each floor, choose a new Class from a random list of three provided by the GM. You gain a random assortment of the new Class’s abilities for the remainder of the current floor, while keeping your current ones. For each bullet point line item in the new Class descrip- tion, roll 1d2. On a 2, you gain the listed abilities. UPGRADES Rank 5: The random Classes increase in rarity and power based on the crawler’s Stats and Level. Rank 10: Skill Ranks gained in any newly-granted Skills persist from floor to floor, but the starting Ranks of those Skills are lost. Rank 15: You choose the Class from any available.

After that, Ranks in this Skill only increase by magical means and training. Cooldown: Once per scene When an Attack would drop you to 0% Health Bar, roll an Unopposed Skill Check. On Success, drop to 10% instead. UPGRADES Rank 5: No Skill Check required anymore. Rank 10: The crawler’s Health Bar is unaffected by damage that would drop them to 0%. Rank 15: Cooldown is twice per scene. When it trig- gers, the crawler heals to 100% and has +Rank DR until the end of the next round of combat.

abilities.name: Cooking
abilities.description: Intelligence You are skilled in the culinary arts. Once you have your ingredients and 1 hour to prepare it, make an Unopposed Skill Check. On Success, you make edible food for you and your party. UPGRADES Rank 5: It takes you 30 minutes to prepare a meal with makeshift ingredients. Rank 10: The diners gain the day-long “You are full!” Buff: Heal 2 Health Bar slots per hour when not resting. Rank 15: The “You are full!” Buff also causes Debuffs to end if you drop to 10% Health Bar.

abilities.name: Detect Trap
abilities.description: Intelligence When you suspect a room, door, chest, or other object has an active trap, this is the Skill you want. Make an Unopposed Skill Check. Roll with Disadvantage when using this Skill to scan an entire room or while moving. On Success, you are alerted to the presence of a non-magic trap, which typically allows you to avoid triggering it. On Fail, you sense nothing, and a trap may or may not be present. UPGRADES Rank 5: You can detect magical traps. Rank 10: You no longer roll with Disadvantage when searching a broad area or while moving. Rank 15: When you are aware of nearby traps, your party has Advantage on their first Check to avoid or escape the effects.

abilities.name: Double Tap
abilities.description: Passive Limitations: To engage this Skill, you must declare a Double Tap at the start of the combat round, before Mob Actions have been determined. You must then use all of your Actions this round to Attack a single target with the same weapon or Spell. Mark this Skill for advancement anytime you roll an Amazing Success or better while using it. If your first Attack is an Amazing Success or better, your second Attack (if it hits) is upgraded to a Critical Hit. UPGRADES Rank 5: Roll your first Attack with Advantage. Rank 10: If your first Attack is a Standard Success or better, the second Attack (if it hits) is upgraded to a Critical Hit. Rank 15: Roll your second Attack with Advantage. If your second Attack is a Critical Hit or upgraded to one, deal ×3 damage (instead of ×2).

Your HUD reveals hidden doors and passages, unless those passages were crafted by someone with more Ranks in Fabricate or Engineering than you have in this Skill or the passage is entirely natural. UPGRADES Rank 5: You have access to system-concealed dis- plays and the Dungeon Locator. Holographic signs pop up in your HUD, displaying insider information like signs at a zoo. Includes arrows toward City and stronger Bosses. Rank 10: You are able to read hidden sigils (glowing blue circles) used by the showrunners to direct the movement of Mobs. Rank 15: You are able to read hidden messages and redactions in dungeon documents.

abilities.name: Explosives Handling

On Fail, I’m sure the GM will think of something. UPGRADES Rank 5: You are able to determine the type, status, and raw materials of explosives you handle. Rank 10: You are able to craft explosives such as dy- namite as if this were a crafting Skill, though you must have explosive raw materials and a Sapper’s Table (see Crafting, p. 221). Rank 15: You may create explosive raw materials out of non-volatile materials. Your crafting takes half the time.

UPGRADES Rank 5: The area in which you can detect other crawl- ers increases to 5 miles. Rank 10: The area in which you can detect other crawlers increases to 10 miles. Rank 15: You can input a specific crawler’s name and learn their exact location anywhere in the dungeon.

abilities.name: Find Trap
abilities.description: Passive Limitations: Ranks in this Skill only increase by magical means and training. Traps within 5 feet of you appear on your HUD one second prior to triggering the trap, which is often too late to react. UPGRADES Rank 5: Traps appear on your HUD up to 5 seconds before they are triggered. Rank 10: Traps within 10 feet of you appear on your HUD as you approach them. Rank 15: Traps within 15 feet of you appear on your HUD as you approach them.

abilities.name: First Aid
abilities.description: Refer to the listed entry for conditions, damage, cooldowns, and Rank upgrades. Effects are adjudicated at the table.

abilities.name: Gear Head
abilities.description: Limited Skill from Race/Class/item. Requires Engine Stand attachment to Engineering Table (2,000 gold). Build engines and vehicles using the entry’s crafting rules; resolve costs and upgrades at the table.

abilities.name: Goblin Explosives
abilities.description: Intelligence For making Attack Skill Checks with explosives, see Throwing, p. 200. Make an Unopposed Skill Check. Goblin Explosives are so unstable that Critical Fails occur on a Natural 1–4. On Success, you safely use Goblin Explosive devices. UPGRADES Rank 5: Critical Fail occurs on a Natural 3 or less. You are able to determine the type, status, and raw materi- als of Goblin Explosives you handle. Rank 10: Critical Fail occurs on a Natural 2 or less. You are able to craft explosives such as dynamite as if this were a crafting Skill, though you must have explosive raw materials and a Sapper’s Table. See Crafting on p. 221. Rank 15: Critical Fail occurs on a Natural 1 as usual. You may create explosive raw materials out of non-vol- atile materials with the use of a Sapper’s Table. Your crafting takes half the time.

abilities.name: Good First Impression
abilities.description: Refer to the listed entry for conditions, damage, cooldowns, and Rank upgrades. Effects are adjudicated at the table.

abilities.name: Hide in Shadows
abilities.description: Refer to the listed entry for conditions, damage, cooldowns, and Rank upgrades. Effects are adjudicated at the table.

abilities.name: Improvised Explosive Device
abilities.description: Intelligence Use this Skill to manipulate explosive material into bombs and traps without a Sapper’s Table. You literally can’t use one, so you’ll have to make an Explosives Handling Skill Check to avoid issues when crafting your device. Use the rules of Crafting on p. 221. On Success, you create the device. Bombs and traps can have timers and triggering devices more sophisticated than a burning fuse. UPGRADES Rank 5: Your crafting takes half the time. Rank 10: Your devices deal d10s of damage instead of d6s (the default). Rank 15: Your devices can be set to trigger only against a specific Mob, Boss, NPC, or crawler.

abilities.name: Incendiary Device Handling
abilities.description: Intelligence For making Attack Skill Checks with incendiary devic- es, see Throwing, p. 200. Make an Unopposed Skill Check. On Success, you are able to safely handle incendiary devices. UPGRADES Rank 5: You are able to determine the type, status, and raw materials of incendiary devices you handle. Rank 10: You are able to craft incendiary devices as if this were a crafting Skill, though you must have incendiary raw materials and a Sapper’s Table. See Crafting, p. 221. Rank 15: Add a +5 Splash to your crafted device at no additional Difficulty, and your crafting takes half the time.

abilities.name: Infusion
abilities.description: Intelligence Limitations: Requires an Infusion Station attachment on an Alchemy Table or Tier 3 Sapper’s Table. Use this Skill to infuse potion bonuses onto consum- able items. One potion can infuse one item. You’ll ei- ther need to learn Alchemy so you can craft your own potions, or find potions to transfer to consumables. Example: Infuse a Hobgoblin Smoke Curtain with an Invisibility potion to create a Hobgoblin Disco Ball. See Crafting, p. 221. On Success, your consumable item now does more! UPGRADES Rank 5: One potion can infuse 2 items at once. Rank 10: One potion can infuse 5 items at once. Rank 15: One potion can infuse 10 items at once.

abilities.name: Intimidate
abilities.description: Refer to the listed entry for conditions, damage, cooldowns, and Rank upgrades. Effects are adjudicated at the table.

abilities.name: Investigation
abilities.description: Refer to the listed entry for conditions, damage, cooldowns, and Rank upgrades. Effects are adjudicated at the table.

abilities.name: Iron Stomach
abilities.description: Constitution Eat magic items for fun and profit! But beware of cursed items, as they could have negative effects. Make an Unopposed Skill Check. On Success, you eat the item. It is destroyed, as the shitter will be tomorrow morning. On an Amazing Success or better, gain 1 permanent Intelligence. UPGRADES Rank 5: On a Critical Hit, gain 1 additional permanent Intelligence. Rank 10: On a Standard Success or better, gain 1 permanent Intelligence. You may eat cursed items with no ill effects. Rank 15: You choose which Stat is permanently increased.

abilities.name: Jumping
abilities.description: Refer to the listed entry for conditions, damage, cooldowns, and Rank upgrades. Effects are adjudicated at the table.

abilities.name: Leadership
abilities.description: Charisma You are skilled at coordinating two or more separate parties during fights against Bosses. Make an Int-Op- posed Skill Check. On Success, the parties have Advantage on their first Attack against the Boss. UPGRADES Rank 5: You may instead use this Skill during Skill challenges while on a group Quest. Perform a free Call a Play Action, and it extends to each member of the parties during their next non-combat Skill Check. Rank 10: Instead of Advantage, anyone in the parties may perform a free Move Action. Rank 15: Instead of Advantage, anyone in the parties may perform a free Evade Action.

abilities.name: Light On Your Feet
abilities.description: Dexterity Limitations: Usable only by animals With a running start of at least 10 feet (made as a 10ft Step with this Skill), you leap through the air in an arc- ing trajectory. Make an Unopposed Skill Check. On Success, you leap a distance in feet up to your Rank ×2 with a height equal to your Dex ×2 in feet. UPGRADES Rank 5: Your distance is Rank ×3 and your height is Dex ×3. Rank 10: You may leap without an arcing trajectory, which allows for “straight up.” Rank 15: Your leap may last up to your Rank in sec- onds, which resembles gliding.

abilities.name: Lockpicking
abilities.description: Dexterity Limitations: Roll with Disadvantage if you do not have the proper tools, unless it’s a crude lock. You spend the Floor number in minutes trying to pick the lock. Make an Unopposed Skill Check (more com- plex locks may have a higher Difficulty, as determined by the GM). If the lock was created by a named antago- nist, this could be an Int-Opposed Skill Check instead. On Success, you pick the lock! UPGRADES Rank 5: You make no noise and leave no trace. Rank 10: Each attempt takes half the time. You may alter the lock so that the key no longer works. Rank 15: You don’t roll with Disadvantage if you lack the proper tools.

abilities.name: Lore
abilities.description: Intelligence You have studied the goings-on in the Dungeon and have figured out a thing or two. Make an Unopposed Skill Check. On Success, you know a little something about a neighborhood, some of the Mobs, or how to avoid pissing off the locals. UPGRADES Rank 5: You can identify the major factions in the area. Rank 10: You are aware of the important local NPCs. Just give your GM a break and don’t demand this all up front or the first one you come across will likely attack you. Rank 15: You roll with Advantage on your first Charis- ma-based Skill Check when encountering an organized group in a neighborhood.

abilities.name: Negotiation
abilities.description: Refer to the listed entry for conditions, damage, cooldowns, and Rank upgrades. Effects are adjudicated at the table.

abilities.name: Pathfinder
abilities.description: HUD map zoom scales with Rank. Rank increases require magic or training. Saferoom/stairwell alerts and other upgrades are adjudicated at the table.

abilities.name: Perception
abilities.description: Refer to the listed entry for conditions, damage, cooldowns, and Rank upgrades. Effects are adjudicated at the table.

abilities.name: Performance
abilities.description: Refer to the listed entry for conditions, damage, cooldowns, and Rank upgrades. Effects are adjudicated at the table.

abilities.name: Persuasion
abilities.description: Refer to the listed entry for conditions, damage, cooldowns, and Rank upgrades. Effects are adjudicated at the table.

abilities.name: Regeneration
abilities.description: Passive If your Rank in this Skill is equal to or greater than your Con, you heal 1 Health Bar slot at the start of each round (or every 10 seconds outside of combat). If not, you heal 1 Health Bar slot every other round (or every 20 seconds outside of combat). UPGRADES Rank 5: After 5 minutes, any Minor Injury Debuff you suffer from ends. After 10 minutes, any Major Injury Debuff you suffer from ends. Rank 10: After 20 minutes, any Long-Term Minor Injury Debuff you suffer from ends. After 1 hour, any Long-Term Major Injury Debuff you suffer from ends. Rank 15: The time required to end injury Debuffs is halved.

abilities.name: Religion
abilities.description: Intelligence You have a knack for understanding gods, their follow- ers, and what makes them tick. Make an Unopposed Skill Check. On Success, you know the basic information about a god and the practices of their followers. UPGRADES Rank 5: You can identify the followers on sight, even if they’re trying to hide their affiliation. Rank 10: You know how to sow discord among the followers of that religion. Rank 15: You know strengths and weakness of the gods.

abilities.name: Repair
abilities.description: Refer to the listed entry for conditions, damage, cooldowns, and Rank upgrades. Effects are adjudicated at the table.

abilities.name: Riding
abilities.description: Dexterity Limitations: The rider in control of the mount rolls Attack Skill Checks with Disadvantage. While mounted on a living beast, you can ride to the local watering hole without needing to make a Check. But during an action scene or when exploring Giant Gopher Hole Flats, your mount might panic, and you might get tossed for 1d6 bludgeoning for every 10ft Move your mount has, plus its size value. Don’t land in a cactus patch! Make an Unopposed Skill Check. On Success, your mount doesn’t stumble, and you stay upright. UPGRADES Rank 5: Your mount has +5ft Move. You no longer suffer Disadvantage when attacking while Riding. Rank 10: Your mount has an additional +10ft Move. When other crawlers in your party roll this Skill un- trained, they roll as normal (not with Disadvantage). Rank 15: Your mount has an additional +15ft Move. When performing crazy stunts (like jumping through flames), roll with Advantage.

abilities.name: Ropework
abilities.description: Dexterity You know a half hitch from a clove hitch, and the quali- ties of hemp vs. nylon (we had to look it up). Sadly, this knowledge is mostly used to tie people up so you can tor—interrogate them, but you’re going to buck that trend, right? Just climbing and cattle-rustling for you! Make an Unopposed Skill Check. On Success, you rope the thing with a good knot. UPGRADES Rank 5: You can now use this Skill as an Attack, at a Range of 10ft vs. the target’s Evade. On Success, the target gains the Held Debuff. Rank 10: You can whip your line in that special way to untie a knot you made and recover your rope. Rank 15: Your Attack now has a Range of your Strength (min 15). Just make sure your rope is long enough.

abilities.name: Running
abilities.description: Refer to the listed entry for conditions, damage, cooldowns, and Rank upgrades. Effects are adjudicated at the table.

abilities.name: Salvage
abilities.description: Refer to the listed entry for conditions, damage, cooldowns, and Rank upgrades. Effects are adjudicated at the table.

abilities.name: Scutelliphily
abilities.description: Intelligence Limitations: This Limited Skill can only be learned via a Race, Class, or item. You know your way around patches and love collecting them. Make an Unopposed Skill Check. On Success, you are able to identify a patch and its bonus level, if any. UPGRADES Rank 5: You can sew and iron patches onto clothing using this Skill. Rank 10: You may use this as a crafting Skill, but crafting tables provide no bonuses. Enchanted patches are limited to one per Gear slot and do not take up Accessory slots. See Crafting, p. 221. Rank 15: Your crafting Checks take half the time. In- crease the bonus value of your enchantments with this Skill by 1, at no additional Difficulty or time to craft. Example: If you craft a +2 Strength patch, it becomes a +3 Strength patch.

abilities.name: Shield Block
abilities.description: Interrupt requiring a shield; not against AoE. Spend one Action for separate Checks vs physical Attacks. Success halves damage before DR. Shield wear, timing and upgrades are manual.

abilities.name: Sleight of Hand
abilities.description: Refer to the listed entry for conditions, damage, cooldowns, and Rank upgrades. Effects are adjudicated at the table.

abilities.name: Smithing
abilities.description: Strength You may craft mundane items such as horseshoes, railroad spikes, nails, or the fun stuff: armor and weapons, but without DR or any bonuses. See Crafting, p. 221. UPGRADES Rank 5: You may craft items up to a +5 bonus. Rank 10: You may craft items up to a +10 bonus. Rank 15: Your crafting with this Skill takes half the time.

abilities.description: Refer to the listed entry for conditions, damage, cooldowns, and Rank upgrades. Effects are adjudicated at the table.

abilities.name: Tactics
abilities.description: Refer to the listed entry for conditions, damage, cooldowns, and Rank upgrades. Effects are adjudicated at the table.

abilities.name: Tattoo Artistry
abilities.description: Dexterity Used to stick and poke ink under someone’s skin to create a mundane tattoo. See Crafting, p. 221 for mag- ical tattoos. UPGRADES Rank 5: You may craft tattoos with up to a +5 bonus. Rank 10: You may craft tattoos with up to a +10 bonus. Rank 15: Your crafting with this Skill takes half the time.

abilities.description: Refer to the listed entry for conditions, damage, cooldowns, and Rank upgrades. Effects are adjudicated at the table.

abilities.name: Trap Engineer
abilities.description: Intelligence Used to craft traps via a Sapper’s Table with a Trap Module (3,000 gold). See Crafting, p. 221. UPGRADES Rank 5: Roll with Advantage when making non-explo- sive traps. Rank 10: Your traps can be set to trigger only against a specific Mob, Boss, NPC, or crawler. Rank 15: Add a +5 Splash to your trap at no addition- al Difficulty, and your crafting takes half the time.

abilities.name: Zone of Control
abilities.description: Requires a Reach weapon. Once per round, spend an Action for an Interrupt Attack with Disadvantage when a foe first enters an adjacent space. Resolve timing and rank upgrades at the table.

abilities.name: Air Buddy
abilities.description: “There’s no dungeon rule that a dog can’t fly.” Passive, Favored: Mage Mana Cost: 12 Range: Self You launch yourself with enough force to fly, hurtling for- ward from your current position up to 10 × your Int Mod away. You land safely if you land on solid ground; other- wise, you fall (see p. 76). You can cast this twice in a row to “double jump” just like in platforming video games. UPGRADES Rank 5: You may choose one additional willing target up to your size at touch range, who you bring with you. Rank 10: You can fly up to 20 × your Int Mod away with this spell. Rank 15: You may choose up to five additional willing targets up to your size at touch range to bring with you.

abilities.name: Astral Paw
abilities.description: “You have summoned an Astral Paw. Yes, just the paw. Budget constraints.” Passive Mana Cost: 12 Range: 30 feet Duration: Until the end of combat or 5 minutes. You conjure a spectral hand, paw, or claw, looking much like your own. You can use this astral appendage to manipulate objects up to 30ft away by spending an Action. You can use the Astral Paw to make Skill Checks but suffer Disadvantage due to a lack of fine control. UPGRADES Rank 5: Your Pugilism and Slice Attacks with the Paw add 1 Astral Paw Rank damage die. Rank 10: You can conjure a paw up to four size categories larger than your own, and the range increases to 50 feet. Rank 15: The caster no longer suffers Disadvantage when performing suitable Skill Checks using the paw, and the duration is 15 minutes.

abilities.name: Bad Faith
abilities.description: “The system has classified your prayers as a hostile act.” Attack, Necrotic, Charisma, Favored: Cleric Mana Cost: 10 Range: 40 feet An unholy pres- ence invades your victim’s mind, body, and soul. Base Damage: 1d8 + Cha Necrotic UPGRADES Rank 5: +1d8 base damage, +5ft Splash Rank 10: +1d8 base damage, and end all Buffs on the victims for the duration of the combat. Rank 15: +1d8 base damage, +5ft Splash

abilities.name: Bang Bro
abilities.description: “When you want more zing in your zinger.” Passive Mana Cost: 5 Range: 5 feet Duration: 5 minutes + 1 minute per Rank Cooldown: 15 minutes Place a hot and crackling temporary enchantment on a weapon you are holding. Your weapon deals +2 mixed Fire and Electric damage. UPGRADES Rank 5: +1d6 Fire and Electric damage Rank 10: +1d6 Fire and Electric damage, and on an Amazing Success, the target of the weapon attack gains the Burned Debuff. Rank 15: +1d6 Fire and Electric damage, and on an Amazing Success, the target of the weapon attack also gains the Shocked Debuff.

abilities.name: Clockwork Triplicate
abilities.description: “If one is good, then three is a party.” Passive Mana Cost: 26 Range: 5 feet Duration: 1 minute per Rank Limitations: Only castable on pets and minions. When you cast this spell upon your pet or minion, it splits into three, each with its full complement of abilities. You must spend an Action making an Unopposed Animal Handling Skill Check to issue a new command to each one separately. UPGRADES Rank 5: Duration is 2 minutes per Rank. Rank 10: Duration is 3 minutes per Rank. Rank 15: When you command your pet or minion, the clockwork versions follow suit.

abilities.name: Confusing Fog
abilities.description: “Visibility reduced. Decision-making questionable.” Passive Mana Cost: 6 Range: 40 feet Duration: Until the end of two full rounds of combat or 20 seconds Cooldown: 15 minutes You create a billowing cloud of fog that you, your party members, and friendly NPCs can see through, but it obscures the area from Mobs, making it more difficult for them to attack you. Mobs attack with Disadvantage (see Mob Advantage and Disadvantage, p. 60) against targets in the fog. This fog fills a 25 × 25ft area. Smart Mobs may attempt to move the combat out of the fog if able. UPGRADES Rank 5: The fog fills a 50 × 50ft area, and its duration is 1 minute. Rank 10: The fog fills a 100 × 100ft area and lasts for 5 minutes. Rank 15: The fog fills a 500 × 500ft area and lasts for 15 minutes.

abilities.name: Dirt Clod
abilities.description: Refer to the listed entry for conditions, damage, cooldowns, and Rank upgrades. Effects are adjudicated at the table.

abilities.name: Drain Life
abilities.description: “Organic tether deployed. Try not to think about where it’s been.” Attack, Necrotic Mana Cost: 14 Range: 30 feet Limitations: For a brief instant, you create a disgust- ing blood vein that reaches out and wraps itself around your target. Base Damage: 1d6 + Int Necrotic UPGRADES Rank 5: +1d6 base damage, and if the target loses at least 3 Health Bar slots, you heal 1 Health Bar slot. Rank 10: +1d6 base damage, and if you heal this way, heal +1 Health Bar slot. Rank 15: +1d6 base damage, and if you heal this way, heal +1 Health Bar slot.

abilities.name: Earworm
abilities.description: “Hitting every note except the right ones.” Attack, Sonic, Charisma, Favored: Bard Mana Cost: 6 Range: 30ft Cooldown: Once per round. Sing a terrible song targeting the ear holes of a victim. Yes, sing a few bars so the GM understands the pain you’re inflicting. Base Damage: 1d6 + Cha Sonic UPGRADES Rank 5: +1d6 base damage. Rank 10: +1d6 base damage, and the target gains the Queasy Debuff. Rank 15: +1d6 base damage and +10ft Splash.

abilities.name: Fear
abilities.description: “Run away, little piggies!” Attack, Mind Control Mana Cost: 3 Range: 25 feet Limitations: Warning: Scary-ass Mobs are immune to Fear effects (GM’s discretion). Target a non-Boss Mob of half your level or less. On a Standard Success, it stands its ground, but it loses its Dex Mod for the duration of the combat. On a higher success, it uses two of its Actions during the next round to run away. UPGRADES Rank 5: +5ft Blast radius. Rank 10: +5ft Blast radius, and on a Critical Hit, the affected creatures gain the Paralyzed Debuff. Rank 15: +5ft Blast radius.

abilities.name: Fireball
abilities.description: “It almost reluctantly meanders toward you. Then your world explodes.” Attack, Fire, Area of Effect Mana Cost: 45 Range: 80 feet Cooldown: Once per scene A creeping beach ball-sized sphere of fire emanates from you. Since it moves so slowly, your attack is made with Disadvantage. When the impact zone has been determined, each creature in a 10ft Blast radius takes full damage. On Fail, roll 1d8 for direction (see Figure 3, p. 200). The amount the Skill Check missed by is the distance away in feet it impacts. Base Damage: 1d12 + Int Fire, 10ft Blast radius UPGRADES Rank 5: +1d12 base damage. Those who lose 1 or more Health Bar slots via this attack gain the Burned Debuff. Rank 10: +1d12 base damage and becomes an 80ft Line attack (and keeps the Blast). Rank 15: +1d12 base damage and +40ft Splash (on the Blast).

abilities.name: Fire Fingers
abilities.description: Refer to the listed entry for conditions, damage, cooldowns, and Rank upgrades. Effects are adjudicated at the table.

abilities.name: Frost Scar
abilities.description: Refer to the listed entry for conditions, damage, cooldowns, and Rank upgrades. Effects are adjudicated at the table.

abilities.name: Grand Illusion
abilities.description: “Why, yes, that is my pet T-Rex.” Intelligence Mana Cost: 7 Range: 40 feet Duration: 2 minutes Cooldown: 15 minutes You create an illusion that might trick your foes. Make a single Int-Opposed Spell Check vs. foes who can see it. Your same roll is used against foes who see it even after the casting round. Mundane illusions seeking only to impress might be rolled with Advantage, while complex illusions seek- ing a specific response or images that suddenly pop up during combat might be rolled with Disadvantage (GM’s discretion). On Success, they believe your illusion. UPGRADES Rank 5: Those who believe gain the Woozy Debuff or similar based on the desired response. Rank 10: Those who believe also gain the Queasy Debuff or similar based on the desired response. Rank 15: Those who believe also gain the Shocked Debuff or similar based on the desired response.

abilities.name: Heal
abilities.description: Spend 2 Mana to restore 2 Health Bar slots on yourself. Cannot cast while Dying. Rank 1 maximum.

abilities.name: Heal Critter
abilities.description: “Your pet has been restored to maximum cuddle capacity.” Heal, Interrupt, Passive Mana Cost: 8 Range: 30 feet Limitations: May only be cast on pets and minions (sorry, Donut). The target glows as they heal back to 100% Health Bar. UPGRADES Rank 5: The target mends a Minor Injury Debuff. Rank 10: The target mends a Major Injury Debuff. Rank 15: The target regrows all lost appendages.

abilities.name: Heal Others
abilities.description: “Tell me you’re a Cleric without…” Heal, Interrupt, Passive Mana Cost: 6 Range: 30 feet Limitations: You can’t cast this Spell on yourself, pets, or minions. A wave of positive vibes engulfs the target. They heal 1d4 Health Bar slots. UPGRADES Rank 5: The target heals 1d6 Health Bar slots. Rank 10: The target heals 2d6 Health Bar slots. Rank 15: Instead of a single target, all party members within a 20ft Burst radius are healed.

abilities.name: Heal Self
abilities.description: “Way easier than manually shoving your guts back in!” Heal, Interrupt, Passive Mana Cost: 1 Range: Self only Limitations: You can only case this Spell on yourself. You center yourself, using magic to make yourself whole. You heal 1d4 Health Bar slots. UPGRADES Rank 5: You heal 1d6 Health Bar slots and mend a Minor Injury, Poison, or Disease Debuff. Rank 10: You heal 2d6 Health Bar slots and mend a Major Injury or other Debuff. Rank 15: You heal to full and gain the benefits of a short rest.

abilities.name: Hole
abilities.description: “It’s a hole. This will absolutely be misused.” Passive Mana Cost: 12 Range: 10 feet Duration: Until the end of the combat or 5 minutes. Limitations: Can’t be used on saferoom doors or living things. You create a temporary cylindrical hole in a surface or material within range, to a depth of 1 inch per Spell Rank and a diameter of 2ft. Anything that can fit in the hole can pass through it if the hole is deep enough to penetrate to the other side of the surface. UPGRADES Rank 5: You can reduce the diameter of the hole to a smaller size when cast. Rank 10: You can widen the hole’s diameter by 1 inch for every inch of depth you sacrifice when cast. Rank 15: The caster may end the spell with a thought (like an Interrupt, but it doesn’t cost an Action). Any- thing in the hole at that time is destroyed.

abilities.name: Holy Aura
abilities.description: “Look who’s all high and mighty.” Attack, Holy, Area of Effect, Charisma, Favored: Cleric & Paladin Mana Cost: 7 Range: 5ft Burst radius Cooldown: Once per round You channel your deity and emanate their essence to hurt only the enemies around you. Base Damage: 1d4 + Cha Holy, 5ft Burst radius UPGRADES Rank 5: +1d4 base damage, and affected undead Mobs take double damage. Rank 10: +1d4 base damage and +5ft Burst radius. Rank 15: +1d4 base damage and +5ft Burst radius.

abilities.name: Hot Stuff Aura
abilities.description: “Bask in the warm glow of my machismo!” Passive, Area of Effect, Favored: Bard Mana Cost: 8 Range: 5ft Burst radius Duration: 2 rounds Cooldown: 5 minutes You create a shield of pure sex appeal around you against all damage types with a number of Health Bar slots equal to your Cha Mod, and a 2 in each slot. It also protects all allies within the radius. When deplet- ed, it disappears. These slots cannot be healed. UPGRADES Rank 5: Increase the Health to 4 in each slot. Rank 10: +5ft Burst radius, with a 6 in each slot. Rank 15: +10ft Burst radius, with a 8 in each slot.

abilities.name: Ice Blast
abilities.description: Ice Attack Spell. Resolve damage and rank upgrades at the table.

abilities.name: Icicles
abilities.description: “Did you know that icicles are the #1 cause of home head impalements?” Attack, Ice Mana Cost: 19 Range: 60 feet Seizing upon the ice that runs through your veins, icicle projectiles shoot forth from your palms towards distant foes. Base Damage: 1d12 + Int Ice UPGRADES Rank 5: +1d12 base damage. Rank 10: +1d12 base damage, and the target gains the Stiff Legs Debuff. Rank 15: +1d12 base damage, and the damage is Armor-Piercing. “It’s pretty cool. I saw you shooting icicles out of your hand.”

abilities.name: Intimate Touches
abilities.description: “Show me on the doll where they healed you.” Heal, Passive, Favored: Cleric & Paladin Mana Cost: 8 Range: 5 feet Limitations: Unlike most healing, this spell is not an Interrupt. You lay hands on the target (which could be you), who heals Health Bar slots equal to your Cha Mod. UPGRADES Rank 5: The target also heals a Minor Injury Debuff. Rank 10: The target also heals a Major Injury Debuff. Rank 15: The target also heals all Poison & Disease Debuffs.

abilities.name: Lightning Bolt
abilities.description: “Bolt released, viewership spike detected.” Attack, Electric Mana Cost: 15 Range: 100 feet With a thunderous clap, you let loose a bolt of lightning. Base Damage: 1d10 + Int Electric UPGRADES Rank 5: +1d10 base damage. Rank 10: +1d10 base damage and becomes a 100ft Line Attack. Rank 15: +1d10 base damage. The lightning bolt forks, and you may choose to apply your Attack against any number of additional targets within 15 feet of the previous target (within the range limit). Each successful Attack (including against the primary target), deals half damage.

abilities.name: Magic Missile
abilities.description: “Standard Spell detected. Viewers appreciate the nostalgia.” Attack, Force Mana Cost: 5 Range: Within your line of sight AI Favor: 1 From glowing eyes, fingers, or whatever, a streak of pure force shoots out. Base Damage: 1d4 + Int Force UPGRADES Rank 5: +1d4 base damage, and you can cast the Spell at a higher or lower Mana cost. 3 Mana: −4 damage 4 Mana: −2 damage 6 Mana: Add 1 Rank damage die Rank 10: +1d4 base damage, and the missiles deal Force and Fire damage. The target gains the Burned Debuff. Rank 15: This attack deals base damage ×3.

abilities.name: Mind Tickle
abilities.description: Refer to the listed entry for conditions, damage, cooldowns, and Rank upgrades. Effects are adjudicated at the table.

abilities.name: Minion Army
abilities.description: “No army can triumph when subjected to internecine conflict.” Intelligence, Area of Effect, Mind Control Mana Cost: 50 Range: 50ft Burst radius Duration: 2 minutes Cooldown: 5 hours Limitations: 5-minute casting time, and the caster cannot move while casting. Only works against Mobs with an Intelligence of 2+. When you cast this spell, choose a target within range. On a Standard Success, 1 in 50 Mobs in the affected area (min 1) become an ally and fight for you without needing to command them. Higher levels of success can turn additional Mobs into allies (GM’s discretion). UPGRADES Rank 5: The casting time is 4 minutes. Duration is 5 minutes. Rank 10: Add your Charisma Stat to the Burst radius. Duration is 10 minutes. Rank 15: Add your Charisma Stat to the Burst radius. Duration is 15 minutes.

abilities.name: Nature’s Breath
abilities.description: “This recycled dungeon air is bad for my complexion.” Heal, Interrupt, Passive, Favored: Druid Mana Cost: 6 Range: 5 feet You blow cool, fresh air over the target’s wounds (could be yourself), healing them. Roll a Nature’s Breath Rank damage die. That is how many Health Bar slots the target heals. May also target pets and minions. UPGRADES Rank 5: Add 1 to your die roll. Rank 10: Add 1 to your die roll, and remove a Minor Injury Debuff. Rank 15: Add 1 to your die roll, and remove a Major Injury Debuff.

abilities.name: Oakhide
abilities.description: “My bark is worse than my bite.” Passive, Favored: Druid Mana Cost: 5 Range: Self Duration: 2 minutes Cooldown: 10 minutes Your skin turns into solid wood, giving you great protection. You have +2 Damage Resistance for the duration of this spell. UPGRADES Rank 5: +2 DR. Duration is 3 minutes. Rank 10: +2 DR. You may target party members and NPCs up to 10 feet away with this spell. Rank 15: +2 DR. Duration is 4 minutes.

abilities.name: Paladin’s Smite
abilities.description: “Repent or die!” Attack, Holy, Charisma, Favored: Paladin Mana Cost: 11 Range: 30 feet You channel a torrent of divine wrath toward a soon- to-be repentant foe. Base Damage: 1d8 + Cha Holy UPGRADES Rank 5: +1d8 base damage. Rank 10: +1d8 base damage, and the target gains the Take Down Debuff. Rank 15: +1d8 base damage, and the damage is Ar- mor-Piercing (ignores DR).

abilities.name: Panty Dropper
abilities.description: “You know what’s on the menu? Me-n-u.” Charisma, Mind Control, Favored: Bard Mana Cost: 10 Range: 10 feet Duration: 2 minutes or until you finish Cooldown: 5 minutes Make an Int-Opposed Spell Check against a non-Boss target, even in combat. Fighting’s just another form of penetration, after all. On Success, the target wants to jump your bones and won’t let anyone stop them (they cease attacking or doing other things). UPGRADES Rank 5: The duration is 5 minutes. Rank 10: The duration is 10 minutes. Rank 15: The duration is 15 minutes.

abilities.name: Ping
abilities.description: “Here piggy, piggy.” Passive, Area of Effect Mana Cost: 5 Range: 1 mile Burst radius Cooldown: 5 minutes Sends out an audible ping that gives the distance and location of all non-crawlers and non-red-tagged Mobs in a circle around you. It will mark targets beyond the range of your map. You receive information about the Mobs that is “somewhat complete.” Targets hit with Ping will hear an audible ping noise, but they will not know where the ping originated. Environmental factors and obstacles may increase or decrease range. UPGRADES Rank 5: If you know the Fear Spell (see p. 204), you may cast it at no Action cost to affect all eligible Mobs within the Ping range. You only pay the Mana. Rank 10: Environmental factors and obstacles no longer decrease the range, and you receive “mostly complete” information. Rank 15: You pay no Mana to add the Fear Spell, and you receive “entirely complete” information.

abilities.name: Puddle Jumper
abilities.description: “Teleportation doesn’t suck.” Passive Mana Cost: 20 Range: Line-of-sight to the destination surface Limitations: There is a 10-second delay before the effect takes place. Cooldown: 5 hours You and up to 3 party members of your choice teleport to another location. Everyone feels a tingling sensation while waiting for the effect to resolve. UPGRADES Rank 5: The delay is 2 seconds, and the destination doesn’t have to be a surface. Rank 10: The delay is 1 second, and the destination can be anywhere within 1,000 yards in any direction, even if the exact destination cannot be seen. Rank 15: There is no delay, and the destination can be anywhere within 1 mile in any direction, even if the exact destination cannot be seen.

abilities.name: Rise, Dead Minion!
abilities.description: “The bigger they are, the deeper they’re buried.” Attack, Favored: Necromancer Mana Cost: 10 Range: 30 feet Duration: 1 round At your command, a Medium (4) size skeleton emerges from the ground to attack your foe in melee combat, dealing 1d8 + Int Necrotic damage. After the Attack, the skeleton collapses, creating difficult terrain in the space it occupied. UPGRADES Rank 5: The skeleton attacks twice before collapsing. Rank 10: The skeleton increases to size Large (5), and its Attack range is 10 feet. +1d8 base damage. Rank 15: The skeleton increases to size Colossal (7), and its Attack range is 15 feet. Add one Rise, Dead Minion! Rank damage die to the damage.

abilities.name: Rootfoot
abilities.description: “The ground is never empty. It is only sleeping.” Attack, Favored: Druid Mana Cost: 5 Range: 30 feet Duration: 2 rounds Roots reach up from the ground to ensnare a victim of up to Size 4 (Medium). On Success, the victim gains the Held Debuff. The Rank of this Spell is used in the Opposed Difficulty to escape, instead of the default Str. UPGRADES Rank 5: Can target victims up to size Large (5). Duration is 3 rounds. Rank 10: Can target victims up to size Huge (6). Duration is 4 rounds. Rank 15: Can target victims up to size Colossal (7). The victim also gains the Poisoned Debuff.

abilities.name: Second Chance
abilities.description: “Everyone deserves one. Except for Phil. Never Phil.” Passive Mana Cost: 10 Range: 10 feet Duration: 1 minute You raise a Mob with a level lower than your own from the dead. The Mob temporarily becomes your Undead Minion with half of its original Health Bar slots. You spend one Action to command it, then it acts independently with 1 Move Action and 1 other Action (usually an Attack) until given new instructions. UPGRADES Rank 5: The Mob can be up to 5 levels higher than you, and the duration is 5 minutes. Rank 10: The Mob can be up to 10 levels higher than the caster, with a duration of 15 minutes. Rank 15: The Mob can be up to 15 levels higher than the caster, with a duration of 45 minutes.

abilities.name: Shield
abilities.description: “Enjoy the illusion of safety.” Interrupt, Passive Mana Cost: 8 Range: Self Duration: 5 minutes You are surrounded by a translucent force field that moves with you and reduces non-magic damage you take. The Shield has 2 Health Bar slots, each with your Con Mod. When you take damage, reduce these Health Bar slots first. The Spell ends early if the shield loses all its Health Bar slots. You can’t heal a Shield. UPGRADES Rank 5: The Shield has 5 Health Bar slots. Rank 10: The Shield has 10 Health Bar slots. Rank 15: The Shield has 15 Health Bar slots.

abilities.name: Shock Treatment
abilities.description: Refer to the listed entry for conditions, damage, cooldowns, and Rank upgrades. Effects are adjudicated at the table.

abilities.name: Solsplash
abilities.description: “The sun is merely a star close enough to hate us.” Attack, Fire, Constitution, Favored: Druid Mana Cost: 13 Range: 30 feet Beams of concentrated “sunlight” fall upon the victim and those around them. Sunscreen’s not gonna help. Base Damage: 1d8 + Con Fire UPGRADES Rank 5: +1d8 base damage, +5ft Splash. Rank 10: +1d8 base damage and +10ft Splash. Each affected entity who loses at least 3 Health Bar slots this way gains the Burned Debuff. Rank 15: +1d8 base damage and +15ft Splash.

abilities.name: Soul Collector
abilities.description: Refer to the listed entry for conditions, damage, cooldowns, and Rank upgrades. Effects are adjudicated at the table.

abilities.name: Thunderlash
abilities.description: “Loud noises and bad decisions go hand-in-hand.” Attack, Sonic Mana Cost: 12 Range: 50 feet You unleash a whip-like emanation of pure sound which thunders through the air. Base Damage: 1d10 + Int Sonic UPGRADES Rank 5: +1d10 base damage. Rank 10: +1d10 base damage, and this attack deals Armor-Piercing damage (ignores DR). Rank 15: +1d10 base damage, and you can change the range to a 15ft Cone attack.

abilities.name: Torch
abilities.description: “Congratulations. You can now see what’s trying to kill you.” Passive Mana Cost: 1 Range: Self Duration: Until you enter a saferoom or descend to a new floor. You create a magical orb of light that follows slightly above and behind you. It provides bright light for a 20ft radius and dim light for a 20ft radius past that. UPGRADES Rank 5: You can move the orb up to 20 feet away from you. Rank 10: You can move the orb up to 60 feet away from you and can double the radius of the brightness with a thought. Rank 15: You can move the orb up to 100 feet away from you and attach it to a surface as an Action.

abilities.name: Turn Undead
abilities.description: “What is dead should stay dead… and far away.” Attack, Area of Effect, Favored: Bard, Cleric, & Paladin Mana Cost: 9 Range: 10ft Cone Duration: 3 rounds Limitations: Does not work against Bosses. Cooldown: 5 minutes Make a single Cha-Opposed Spell Check vs. the Un- dead Mobs in the affected area. On Success, the Undead Mob runs away for the dura- tion of the Spell. UPGRADES Rank 5: +5ft Cone. Duration is 5 rounds. Rank 10: +10ft Cone. Duration is 10 rounds. Rank 15: +15ft Cone. Duration is 15 rounds. On an Amazing Success or better, the Undead Mob is de- stroyed.

abilities.name: Twinkle Toes
abilities.description: “Fly my pretties, fly!” Intelligence, Passive Mana Cost: 2 Range: 5 feet Duration: A number of seconds equal to your Intelligence. Target a pet or minion within range. It has Move ×2 for the duration. UPGRADES Rank 5: The pet or minion has Move ×3 for the duration. Rank 10: The pet or minion has Move ×4 for the duration. Rank 15: The pet or minion has Move ×5 for the duration.

abilities.name: Unnecessary Force
abilities.description: “Excessive force authorized. Paperwork waived.” Attack, Force Mana Cost: 13 Range: 40 feet A shockwave akin to that of an A-bomb crashes over your target. Base Damage: 1d12 + Int Force UPGRADES Rank 5: +1d12 base damage. Rank 10: +1d12 base damage, and the target is pushed 10 feet. Rank 15: +1d12 base damage, and the target is pushed 15 feet.

abilities.name: Wall Of Fire
abilities.description: “You’re gonna fall in… to a burnin’ ring of fire.” Passive, Fire Mana Cost: 15 Range: 30 feet Duration: 2 rounds Creates a 30ft-long × 7ft-high × 2ft-thick wall of fire. Base Damage: 1d2 Fire for every 1ft of wall the victim passes through, and they gain the Burned Debuff. UPGRADES Rank 5: +1d2 base damage. The wall can be turned into a ring of fire. Duration is 5 rounds. Rank 10: +1d2 base damage. Creates a 50ft-long × 10ft-high × 3ft-thick wall. Duration is 10 rounds. Rank 15: +1d2 base damage. Creates a 100ft-long × 20ft-high × 5ft-thick wall. Duration is 15 rounds.
abilities.damage: 1d2 Fire for every 1ft of wall the victim

abilities.name: Water Breathing
abilities.description: “It’s okay to inhale.” Intelligence, Passive Mana Cost: 2 Range: Self Duration: A number of seconds equal to the caster’s Intelligence ×3. The target can breathe underwater without issue. UPGRADES Rank 5: You may now cast this upon others at a range of 5 feet. Rank 10: The targets roll Swimming Skill Checks with Advantage. Rank 15: You can target any or all individuals within a 15ft Burst radius.

abilities.name: Web
abilities.description: “Blast your goo onto foes!” Attack, Intelligence Mana Cost: 6 Range: 20ft Cone Duration: 2 rounds A cone of sticky webbing shoots from your fingers. Make a single Spell Attack Skill Check vs. each friend and foe’s Evade (if any). On Success, that entity gains the Held Debuff. The Rank of this spell is used in the Opposed Difficulty to escape, instead of Str. UPGRADES Rank 5: +5ft Cone. Duration is 5 rounds. Rank 10: +5ft Cone. Duration is 10 rounds. Rank 15: +5ft Cone. Duration is 15 rounds.

abilities.name: Wilbur’s Slow-Build Fireblast
abilities.description: “Hold. Hold! HOLD!” Attack, Fire Mana Cost: 60 Range: 50 feet Base Damage: 1d8 + Int Fire, and the target gains the Burned Debuff. This Spell can be cast and held as a swirling ring of fire around your ring finger until you unleash it. Only one ring may be held at a time. The next time you perform an Attack Action, it must be this Spell (at no additional Mana cost). If anyone touches the ring with the intent to diffuse it (you may oppose that Action), the Attack hits them for half dam- age. The appendage they touched you with smolders, use- less for a number of rounds equal to the damage inflicted. UPGRADES Rank 5: +1d8 base damage. For each full day you hold the spell, +1d8 Fire damage. Rank 10: +1d8 base damage and +5ft Splash. Rank 15: +1d8 base damage and +5ft Splash.

abilities.name: Wisp Armor
abilities.description: “Empty minds are surprisingly easy to protect.” Passive Mana Cost: 5 Range: Self Duration: 5 minutes Cooldown: 5 minutes You conjure a protective barrier that reduces all magic damage (typically Spells) down to its Rank 1 base dam- age (1 die + Stat Mod) without any Upgrades or other bo- nuses. This Spell also makes you immune to Mind Control. UPGRADES Rank 5: The duration is 10 minutes. Rank 10: The duration is 15 minutes. Rank 15: The duration is 20 minutes.
